name: longitude comment: 经度 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: verified comment: 是否已验证(V1.1预留) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: verified_at comment: 验证时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: verified_source comment: 验证来源(google/usps/loqate) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_at comment: 创建时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: merchant_id comment: 商家ID constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: rule_name comment: 规则名称 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: country_code comment: 国家代码 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: restriction_type comment: 类型(fixed/custom) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: match_field comment: 匹配字段(address_line1/city/state等) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: match_method comment: 匹配方式(keyword/regex/state_select) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: match_pattern comment: 匹配内容(关键词或正则) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: match_states comment: 限制州列表(JSON,州选择时使用) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: error_message_i18n_key comment: 买家端提示i18n Key(固定) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: address_field_meta comment: 地址字段元数据 note: 字段单一事实来源，后台配置/校验规则/前端表单均引用此表 columns: - name: id comment: 主键 UUID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: field_name comment: 字段标识(=address表列名) constraint: UNIQUE type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: field_type comment: 字段类型(text/select/phone) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: category comment: 分类(recipient/address/geo) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: display_name comment: 后台展示名 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: max_length comment: 数据库列最大长度 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: description comment: 后台说明(给运营) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_at comment: 创建时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: country_address_config comment: 国家地址配置 note: 定义各国地址字段的可见性、必填性和顺序 columns: - name: id comment: 主键 UUID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: country_code comment: 国家代码(引用market) constraint: FOREIGN KEY, UNIQUE type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: enabled comment: 是否启用 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: field_config comment: '字段配置(JSON: enabled)' constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: field_order comment: 字段顺序(JSON) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: field_i18n_keys comment: 字段国际化文案Key(JSON) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: admin_division_level comment: 行政区划层级配置(JSON,如{"state_province":"L1","city":"L2","district":"L3"}) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_at comment: 创建时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: updated_at comment: 更新时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: address_field_validation_rules comment: 地址字段校验规则 note: 技术校验(格式/长度)，按priority顺序执行 columns: - name: id comment: 主键 UUID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: country_code comment: 国家代码 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: field_name comment: 字段名(引用registry) constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: rule_type comment: 规则类型(pattern/length/custom) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: priority comment: 执行优先级(值小先执行) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: pattern comment: 正则表达式(pattern/custom时使用) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: min_length comment: 最小长度(length时使用) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: max_length comment: 最大长度(length时使用) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: execute_on comment: 执行端(client/server/both) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: severity comment: 严重程度(error/warning) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: required_level comment: 必填性(required/optional/conditional) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: error_message_i18n_key comment: 多语言key constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: enabled comment: 是否启用 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_at comment: 创建时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: updated_at comment: 更新时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: administrative_division comment: 行政区划层级 note: 各国行政区划树形数据(州/市/区)，支撑下拉选择 columns: - name: id comment: 主键 UUID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: country_code comment: 国家代码 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: level comment: 层级(1=州/省 2=市 3=区) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: code comment: 行政区划代码 constraint: UNIQUE type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: name comment: 名称 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: name_local comment: 本地语言名称 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: parent_id comment: 父级ID(自引用) constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: sort_order comment: 排序权重 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_at comment: 创建时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: updated_at comment: 更新时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: postal_code_mapping comment: 邮编映射表 note: 邮编→城市/州反查，前端用于联动校验 columns: - name: id comment: 主键 UUID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: country_code comment: 国家代码 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: postal_code comment: 邮政编码 constraint: UNIQUE type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: city comment: 城市 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: state_code comment: 州/省代码 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_at comment: 创建时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: updated_at comment: 更新时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: user comment: 用户(外部) note: 用户模块提供，地址库引用user_id columns: - name: id comment: 用户ID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: email comment: 邮箱 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 账户状态 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: country comment: 国家(market模块) note: MARKET模块提供，地址库引用country_code columns: - name: country_code comment: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: name comment: 国家名称 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: enabled comment: 是否启用 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: currency_code comment: 货币代码 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: merchant comment: 商家(外部) note: 商家模块提供，配送限制引用merchant_id columns: - name: id comment: 商家ID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: name comment: 商家名称 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 商家状态 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: relations: - from: user to: address type: 1:N label: 拥有多个地址 color: '#1565C0' penwidth: 1.8 - from: country to: address type: 1:N label: 地址所属国家 color: '#7B1FA2' penwidth: 1.4 - from: country to: country_address_config type: '1:1' label: 国家字段配置 color: '#7B1FA2' penwidth: 1.4 - from: country to: address_field_validation_rules type: 1:N label: 校验规则(按国家) color: '#E8833A' penwidth: 1.4 - from: country to: postal_code_mapping type: 1:N label: 邮编数据 color: '#7B1FA2' penwidth: 1.4 - from: country to: administrative_division type: 1:N label: 行政区划数据 color: '#7B1FA2' penwidth: 1.4 - from: administrative_division to: administrative_division type: 1:N label: 父子层级(自引用) color: '#E8833A' penwidth: 1.2 style: dashed - from: address_field_meta to: country_address_config type: 1:N label: field_config引用字段元数据 color: '#2E7D32' penwidth: 1.4 style: dashed - from: address_field_meta to: address_field_validation_rules type: 1:N label: field_name引用元数据 color: '#2E7D32' penwidth: 1.4 - from: merchant to: delivery_restriction type: 1:N label: 商家配送限制 color: '#7B1FA2' penwidth: 1.4 - from: country to: delivery_restriction type: 1:N label: 国家配送限制 color: '#7B1FA2' penwidth: 1.4 - from: country_address_config to: administrative_division type: 1:N label: admin_division_level映射 color: '#2E7D32' penwidth: 1.2 style: dashed design_rules: superset_fields: 超集字段设计：数据库包含所有国家字段，通过country_address_config控制展示 field_registry: address_field_meta是字段的单一事实来源 admin_division_mapping: admin_division_level存储在country_address_config中(JSON)，数据驱动行政区划映射：state_province→L1, city→L2, district→L3 market_integration: 国家可用性引用market模块，地址库不独立维护国家列表 frontend_i18n: 前端多语言采用i18n方案，数据库不存储多语言字段 name_split: recipient_first_name + recipient_last_name 拆分存储，支持支付AVS和物流API name_concat: recipient_name 冗余存储拼接结果 soft_delete: 地址数据支持软删除(CCPA要求可彻底删除) encryption: phone_number, recipient_first_name, recipient_last_name 字段 AES-256 加密存储 place_id_dedup: 通过 place_id 做地址去重(V1.1) mvp_scope: MVP只启用美国(US) merchant_isolation: 配送限制多商家隔离：自营平台有独立merchant_id，与其他商家平级，每个商家各自独立管理自己的规则 fixed_rule_immutable: '固定规则(restriction_type=fixed): PO Box/军事地址，系统初始化不可修改识别逻辑，仅可toggle启用/禁用' fixed_rule_i18n: 固定规则i18n key固定：delivery_restriction.po_box / delivery_restriction.military，各自独立多语言文案 custom_rule_i18n: 自定义规则统一i18n key：delivery_restriction.general，文案固定"该地址不支持配送"，不支持自定义 no_scope_no_inheritance: 无适用范围概念：平台管自营、商家管自己，互不干涉、不存在继承或强制关系 delivery_check_logic: 地址校验时：按订单中商品的merchant_id查询对应商家已启用的配送限制规则进行校验 category_removed: delivery_restriction不再包含category字段，全品类生效为默认行为无需存储 public_data_ownership: 公共数据(国家地址配置/行政区划/邮编)由超级管理员维护，不区分商家
